text: The office should definitely consider moving to the riverside building. Firstly, the riverside building has passed a flood-zone certification with the highest safety margin in the district, ensuring a secure and reliable working environment for the team. Secondly, the building offers a unique glass atrium workspace, enhancing collaboration and creativity among employees. Moreover, the new lease is 11% cheaper than the current one, reducing costs without compromising on quality. Lastly, the success of three firms that relocated to this building in the past decade underscores its potential for smooth transition and long-term benefits.
